topic: Parts and functions of the eye
key_concepts: The cornea is the clear covering at the front of the eye
The iris is the colored part of the eye
The iris controls the amount of light entering the eye
The pupil is the circular opening where light enters
The lens focuses light and projects the image onto the retina
The retina is where the image is focused at the back of the eye
The optic nerve sends messages about the image to the brain
Avoid placing pointed objects near the eyes
Read with enough light and rest the eyes after long reading
Eat foods rich in vitamin A for eye health
Avoid rubbing the eyes and rinse with clean running water when dirt gets in
